title: 高盛CEO：AI治理三原则，金融业如何守住人类责任底线？
speaker: David Solomon

segments.en: The op-ed that I put forward was to try to participate in the dialogue that this is a very powerful technology and a lot of wonderful things that are going to come from it. I'm super
segments.zh: 我提出的评论文章是为了参与对话，说明这是一项非常强大的技术，将带来许多美好的事物。我非常

segments.en: excited about what the technology can do in areas like health and science and also what it can do in business and enterprise to increase productivity, but it also needs a governance structure around it.
segments.zh: 兴奋于这项技术在健康和科学等领域能做什么，以及在商业和企业中能做什么来提高生产力，但它也需要一个治理结构。

segments.en: And, you know, I think that governance structure requires some simple principles that have always been the principles of responsible business and technology to point. The first is government
segments.zh: 而且，我认为治理结构需要一些简单的原则，这些原则一直是有责任心的商业和技术的原则。首先，政府

segments.en: has to set some rules in the road. The second is the people that make the technology have to be responsible and thoughtful about what they make and how they sell it into the market. And the third
segments.zh: 必须制定一些规则。其次，制造技术的人必须对他们制造的东西以及如何将其销售到市场负责和深思熟虑。第三

segments.en: is that the enterprises, like a Goldman Sachs or other financial institutions, or other industrial companies that take that technology and deploy it into their enterprises have to be responsible for

segments.zh: 数亿美元。你知道，有些人对该技术部署到我们的平台中负有责任。所以我认为有
